limitations: Counts reflect visible Railway indexed logs matching the specified filter, not all user attempts or an error-rate denominator.
SSE HTTP 200 does not establish business success.
Error levels are not reliable cancellation classes; AbortError alone must not be downgraded.
Repeated events from the same request and paired job.error/job.finished must not be added as independent incidents.
Only allowlisted metadata is persisted. No user/Telegram/session/character IDs, message contents, URLs, secrets or arbitrary Error.message are included.
Production function definitions, SQL plans and database migration ledger were not inspected in this design session.
